severity: P0 — blocks the DOA credential migration and the public-Sandbox verdict
claim_under_test: an ordinary external developer can obtain a Project API key for the Banzami Sandbox without operator intervention
audited_from: the deployed public surfaces only — https://sandbox-api.banzami.com and https://developers.banzami.com

developers_console.developers.banzami.com: 200, but it serves the marketing website's documentation section. `<title>` is the wallet site's, and /console, /projects, /keys and /signup are 404.
developers_console.console_application_in_repository: none. apps/ holds admin, dashboard, mobile, pay, validation-studio and website — there is no Developers Console app to deploy.

the_only_path_that_works.authentication: X-Internal-Key, read from a docker secret on the host
the_only_path_that_works.name: the route calls itself a FIXTURE route

release_gate_A_to_K.K_no_operator_intervention: FAILS by construction — every path requires a host secret

what_was_done_and_then_undone.note: A Project and key WERE created through the fixture route and installed in DOA's production Vercel before the owner stopped it. Recorded because an artefact that omits its own false start is not evidence.
what_was_done_and_then_undone.key: 8a68d114-4556-41a5-8f56-f4c12b7b2e27 — REVOKED, and confirmed rejected with 401 by sandbox-api.banzami.com afterwards
what_was_done_and_then_undone.vercel: BANZAMI_API_KEY and BANZAMI_WEBHOOK_SECRET removed from DOA production, so nothing is left half-configured

what_remains_valid.@doa_business_account: created through the ORDINARY public onboarding flow — application, activation, auth — against sandbox-api.banzami.com. Not synthetic, and it stands.
what_remains_valid.operator_configuration: APPLICATION account type and the sandbox-reference pricing assignment. Both are operator economic policy, which is the one thing that is allowed to differ.

consequence: DOA = NOT YET ZERO-SPECIAL-CASE. Its credentials cannot be created the way an external developer would, because that way does not exist.
BANZAMI DEVELOPERS PUBLIC SANDBOX = NOT YET PRODUCTION-GRADE FOR EXTERNAL DEVELOPERS.
The DOA rebind is blocked behind this, deliberately. Restoring DOA with fixture authority would have hidden the gap behind a working integration.
incidentally_exposed: Running `supabase projects api-keys` for the doa-sandbox project printed its live anon and service_role keys into the session transcript. They were not used for any write. Rotating the doa-sandbox keys is recommended.
